reason: I post in our apartment WhatsApp group and go with whoever a neighbour vouches for -- that has never let me down, so why would I hand my house keys to a profile I only found by scrolling an app?
objection: Anyone can upload an ID card. 'Verified' on a screen means nothing to me until an actual person I know has had this electrician or tutor in their house and said it went fine.
would_change_my_mind: If two or three people in my own WhatsApp group had already used it and said the freelancer showed up on time and did good work -- then I'd try it, because that's basically the same trust I already use, just with an app attached.
